title: Noise operator on a degree component
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$. Applying the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ to the degree-$k$ component of $f$ gives the function $x\mapsto \rho^k$ times that degree-$k$ component evaluated at $x$.
